desks.name: Anti-Ragging Committee & Squad
desks.head: Principal & Anti-Ragging Committee Squad Leaders
desks.location: Principal's Office / Administrative Building, Ground Floor
desks.actionGuidance: SRKR maintains a ZERO TOLERANCE policy on ragging. If you experience or witness any form of ragging, harassment, or intimidation, contact this squad or the Principal immediately without fear. All reports are kept strictly confidential.

desks.name: Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) & Women Protection Cell
desks.head: Presiding Officer / Senior Female Faculty Convenor
desks.actionGuidance: Dedicated to preventing gender harassment and addressing grievances of female students and staff in strict accordance with the POSH Act and UGC directives. Absolute privacy and immediate redressal guaranteed.

desks.name: Student Grievance Redressal Committee (SGRC)
desks.head: Dean of Student Affairs / Committee Chairman
desks.actionGuidance: Submit written or online petitions regarding academic disputes, unfair evaluation, faculty concerns, canteen/amenities issues that were not resolved at the departmental level.

desks.name: Controller of Examinations (Autonomous COE)
desks.head: Dr. M. Siva Krishnam Raju (Controller of Examinations)
desks.actionGuidance: For revaluation/recounting applications, semester-end results, grade memo corrections, official transcripts for WES/higher studies, duplicate certificates, and backlog clearance records via the official exams portal www.srkrexams.in.

desks.name: Admissions & Verification Desk
desks.head: Dean / Convener of Admissions
desks.location: Administrative Block, Admissions Counter, Ground Floor
desks.actionGuidance: For Category-A EAPCET verification, Category-B (Management quota) seat availability and counseling, lateral entry admissions, and original certificate deposit/return.

desks.name: Training & Placement Cell (Corporate Relations)
desks.head: Dr. K. R. Satyanarayana (Dean Placements)
desks.actionGuidance: For recruiters seeking on-campus or virtual recruitment slots, pre-placement talks, student resume verification, internship NOCs, and placement statistics.

desks.name: Alumni Association Office & Coordination Cell
desks.head: Dr. G. Harish Kumar Varma (Dean, Student Affairs & Alumni) / Dr. V. K. Viswanadha Raju (Coordinator)
desks.actionGuidance: Located on the 1st floor of the AICTE IDEA Lab. Handles global alumni networking, guest lecture coordination, student mentorship, reunion events, endowment funds, and campus visit coordination.

desks.name: Hostel Administration & Chief Wardens
desks.head: Chief Warden (Boys Hostel) & Senior Lady Warden (Girls Hostel)
desks.location: Hostel Administrative Office, Boys Hostel Block-A / Girls Hostel Main Gate
desks.actionGuidance: For room allotment, hostel fee payment receipts, special diet/mess inquiries, hostel gate passes, and emergency parental contacts.

desks.name: Accounts & Scholarships Section (JVD / Fee Desk)
desks.head: Finance Officer / Scholarship Coordinator
desks.location: Administrative Block, Accounts Wing, Ground Floor
desks.actionGuidance: For tuition fee payment receipts, Jagananna Vidya Deevena (JVD) biometric authentication, fee reimbursement status, and no-dues clearance.

desks.name: Office of the Principal & Central Reception
desks.head: Dr. K. V. Murali Krishnam Raju (Principal) | Dr. M. Jagapathi Raju (Director)
desks.actionGuidance: Direct office of the Principal. Main Reception phone: 08816-223332 / 08816-229377. Mobile helpline: +91 9848823332. Open 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM (Monday-Saturday, closed on 2nd Saturdays).

desks.name: Physical Director & Department of Physical Education
desks.head: Dr. P. Satyanarayana Raju & Dr. Ch. Hari Mohan (Associate Professors & Physical Directors)
desks.location: Indoor Sports Stadium & Gymnasium Complex, Sports Pavilion
desks.actionGuidance: Manages collegiate sports, university tournament teams, indoor stadium facilities (wooden badminton courts, table tennis), outdoor cricket and football grounds, modern gymnasiums, and sports quota verifications.

desks.name: Central Library & Knowledge Resource Centre
desks.head: Sri G. Srinivasa Raju (In-Charge, Central Library / Assistant Professor)
desks.location: Central Library Building (Opposite Main Administrative Block)
desks.actionGuidance: Open from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM on all working days. Facilitates book lending (100,000+ volumes), IEEE Xplore & ScienceDirect digital library access, DELNET, book bank schemes, and student library no-dues clearance.

desks.name: AICTE IDEA Lab (Innovation & Maker Space)
desks.head: Dr. G. Harish Kumar Varma (Coordinator / Head, EDC) | Sri K. Pavan Kumar (Co-Coordinator / Incharge)
desks.location: AICTE IDEA Lab Building, Ground & 1st Floor
desks.actionGuidance: State-of-the-art innovation and fabrication maker space funded by AICTE. Equipped with 3D printers, CNC laser cutters, PCB fabrication, and IoT testbeds. Conducts hands-on maker workshops, ideathons, and prototype incubation.
